scenes.title: Welcome
scenes.narration: This sampler shows what the block library can draw. Every block animates itself in, and the caption in the corner tracks the voice.

scenes.title: Blocks
scenes.narration: Titles, bullets, cards, stacks, steps, comparisons, code and mnemonics can all be mixed inside a single scene.

scenes.title: Code
scenes.narration: Code blocks type themselves out on screen, which is handy for developer explainers.

blocks.heading: typed live

scenes.title: Outro
scenes.narration: That is the sampler. Make a project and replace this with your own script.
